economy-trade.quote: And no one ever talks about it! If we had invested social security funds in the 1980’s in our markets, our budget would be golden. The government takes your money, gives you an awful return, and then only gives it back to you if you have a long life. Otherwise you get nothing!

The government takes all our money for social security, effectively holds it for decades in savings accounts, and then gives it back to us — only if we live long enough! — at an awful rate of return. It’s complete madness.

Conversations around US involvement in AI company equities are interesting. But the bigger conversation we should be having is this — why is social security indexed to inflation and not to our equity markets? It’s insane we haven’t had this public debate.
